description: This file defines the UserEntity class implementing the UserEntityInterface for OAuth2 integration within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates a user identifier and provides a factory method to create instances from a User entity.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 user entity with a unique identifier, implementing UserEntityInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserEntity with a specific identifier.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the user entity.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a UserEntity from a User entity object.
